versions.changelog:
- Updated version to 1.1.3.
- Minor documentation update in SKILL.md: expanded "projects (GTM as Code)" in the "Going further" section for clarity.
- Removed redundant file: skill-card.md.

- Example table and its output description updated to clarify that missed (no-email) profiles now return empty rows instead of profile-only data.
- Added note in "Worth knowing" section: misses now return no profile at all — use a different skill for profile-only lookups.
- File skill-card.md removed (metadata card).
- Version bump to 1.1.2.

- Added an example section with illustrative batch input/output, showing typical usage and result formatting.
- Updated metadata: new personas (sales-development, account-executive) and changed source type to "one-off".
- Removed the file skill-card.md.

**Expanded triggers and improved setup logic.**

- Added new natural language triggers such as "contact enrichment", "linkedin enrichment", and "pull the whole biography" to support broader use cases.
- Improved setup script to avoid double-counting sessions when Cargo GTM plugin is installed.
- Streamlined documentation for asking users to star the repository, including explicit user consent instructions.
- Removed the deprecated skill-card.md file.

enrich-linkedin-profile 1.0.0

- Initial release providing a single-call way to turn a LinkedIn profile URL into a full person profile plus a verified work email.
- Powered by Cargo and requires @cargo-ai/cli for setup and execution.
- Includes clear setup steps, usage instructions, and cost guidance.
- Only charges credits when a valid email is found; missed lookups are free.
- Designed specifically for cases where you already have LinkedIn URLs — use other skills if you only have names or domains.
- Recommends sampling before bulk runs to verify cost and hit-rate.
